name: snov_domain_search
description: Find every email address on a company domain — "who works at riotgames.com and what are their emails?". Returns emails with first/last name, job position, and type (personal or generic), plus company info, from Snov.io. Complements Hunter domain search. Example: snov_domain_search({ domain: "riotgames.com", limit: 50, _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Snov.io OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from app.snov.io/account/api (paid plan required).

name: snov_email_profile
description: Look up the person behind an email address — "who is john@stripe.com?". Returns the contact's name, current job title and employer, industry, location, and linked social profiles via Snov.io email enrichment. Example: snov_email_profile({ email: "john@stripe.com", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Snov.io OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from app.snov.io/account/api (paid plan required).

name: snov_domain_email_count
description: How many email addresses does Snov.io have for a domain? — a free pre-check before spending credits on a full snov_domain_search. Example: snov_domain_email_count({ domain: "riotgames.com", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Snov.io OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from app.snov.io/account/api (paid plan required).
